senses.gloss: m. (preced.) [incision,] resin gained by tapping, balsam; עץ הק׳ (or sub. עץ) balsam-tree.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:6">Shebi. VII, 6</cite> <he>אין לק׳ וכ׳</he> the law of the Sabbatical year does not apply to the balsam tree; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 5:12">Tosef. ib. V, 12</cite> <he>יש לק׳ שביעית</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>לקט בש׳</he>, corr. acc.) the law does apply; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:5:5">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵇ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Niddah 8b:26">Nidd. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>קְטָפוֹ זה פריו</he> its resin is its fruit.
Ker. 6ᵃ הצרי … מעצי ק׳ tsŏri is the sap that drips from resinous trees.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:11">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00894"><he>בַּלְסָם</he></cite>; a. fr.
